title: LAPLEX: The FFT of Learnable Laplace Kernels
abstract: arXiv:2605.24584v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Fast linear algebra in deep learning usually comes with a choice: fixed geometry and exact computation, as in the Fourier transform, or adaptive geometry paid for by dense parameters, random features, or low-rank surrogates. To move beyond this trade-off, we introduce LAPLEX, a class of exact, trainable (phased) Laplace-kernel operators.   A LAPLEX layer is a typically full-rank dense matrix, implicitly defined by learnable coordinate anchors, with FFT-like scaling. Consequently, it supports trainable matrix--vector operations at vector dimensions up to $10^9$ on modern GPUs. As a neural layer, it yields compact projections and classification heads interpretable as soft, trainable routing models. The same primitive also serves as an efficient Gram operator, enabling high-dimensional covariance models on flattened images of dimension $3 \cdot 10^6$ that preserve visible spatial structure without imposing convolutional bias. translated_title: LAPLEX：可学习拉普拉斯核的快速傅里叶变换
translated_abstract: 深度学习中的快速线性代数通常面临一种权衡选择：要么采用固定几何结构与精确计算（如傅里叶变换），要么为获得自适应几何结构而付出密集参数、随机特征或低秩代理的代价。为了突破这一权衡，我们提出了LAPLEX，一类精确且可训练的（相位化）拉普拉斯核算子。LAPLEX层是一个通常为满秩的稠密矩阵，由可学习的坐标锚点隐式定义，并具有类似FFT的扩展性。因此，它能够在现代GPU上支持向量维度高达10^9的可训练矩阵-向量运算。作为神经层，它可以产生紧凑的投影层和分类头，这些分类头可解释为软性的、可训练的路由模型。同一基元还可用作高效的Gram算子，使得在维度为3×10^6的展平图像上构建高维协方差模型成为可能，既能保留可见的空间结构，又无需施加卷积偏置。
tldr: LAPLEX提出了一类精确且可训练的拉普拉斯核算子层，以FFT式的扩展效率实现了可学习的自适应几何结构，支持高达10^9维度的可训练矩阵运算，并可高效用于高维协方差建模。
en_tdlr: LAPLEX introduces a class of exact, trainable Laplace-kernel operators that combine FFT-like scaling with learnable adaptive geometry, enabling trainable matrix-vector operations at dimensions up to 10^9 and serving as efficient Gram operators for high-dimensional covariance modeling.
